answer.rationale: With 14 days to expiry, no auto-renew, and the line at 94% of committed volume with zero buffer, a primary-vendor switch carries unacceptable delivery risk despite the 18% cost mandate. Negotiating terms with the incumbent leverages three reliable memories: renewal kept integration stable (c1), renegotiation recovered real margin via benchmarking (c4), and multi-year commitment unlocked volume pricing (c6). A benchmarked renegotiation toward a multi-year structure can capture a substantial share of the 18% target without onboarding risk. Verified c2 (switch success) and c4 (renegotiation margin) to confirm the cost-side tradeoff before ruling out a switch; a second source can be pursued next cycle as a hedge.
